description: Materialised relations between repositories. Two edge types, differing in provenance, which is the thing to check before trusting either of them.

stack.derivedFrom: dependency manifests committed to both repositories
stack.method: IDF-weighted cosine over declared packages, ln(N/df), packages above 0.25 document frequency excluded as furniture
stack.evidence: each edge names the shared packages that carried the most weight
stack.answers: built the way you build things

semantic.derivedFrom: neural embedding of the repository description, topics, languages, frameworks and generated summary
semantic.method: cosine similarity in the embedding space
semantic.evidence: none beyond the similarity score itself

clusterProvenance: INFERRED - clusters are built from semantic edges only
